title: Weight of subsets containing a pair
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $b4\in\mathbb{R}$, and let $i,j$ be elements of the $n$-element set $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. Give each subset $J$ of this set weight $w(J)=b4^{|J|}(1-b4)^{n-|J|}$. The sum of the weights of subsets containing both $i$ and $j$ is $b4$ if $i=j$, and $b4^2$ otherwise.
